summary: Writes a3 wide characters from source pointer a2 to a buffered output stream. Fast path: when the double-indirect write-buffer object referenced at this+0x20 is valid (first dword non-zero) and the available-space value read through the pointer stored at this+0x30 is positive, copies as many characters as fit in one chunk and advances the buffer position counter via DoubleIndirectCounterUpdate. Fallback path: writes one character at a time through the virtual single-character write slot (vtable pointer read from this+0, slot at vtable+4), aborting and returning the current total when that call returns 0xFFFF. Returns the total number of wide characters written.

local_names.v5: scratch value: buffer object pointer, available space, clamped chunk length, or single character value
local_names.v6: word write cursor into the write buffer
local_names.v7: source copy pointer during the chunk copy
local_names.v9: running total of wide characters written

operations.description: Initialize running total v9 to 0 before the write loop.
Iterate while the remaining count a3 is greater than 0, writing one wide character (or one chunk) per pass from source pointer a2.
Load the double-indirect write-buffer object pointer stored at this+0x20 and derive the word write cursor v6 from the dword it points at.

Fast chunk path requires the buffer object's first dword (reached through the pointer at this+0x20) to be non-zero and the available-space value read through the pointer stored at this+0x30 to be greater than zero.
Clamp the chunk length v5 to the smaller of the remaining count a3 and the available space.
Copy v5 wide characters from source pointer a2 into the write cursor v6, advancing both pointers.
Advance running total v9 by v5, reduce remaining count a3 by v5, and advance source pointer a2 by v5.
Update the double-indirect write-buffer position counter by the chunk length v5 after the chunk copy.
Fallback single-character path: load the next wide character from a2 as the low word of v5.
Fallback: invoke the virtual single-character write slot (vtable pointer read from this+0, slot at vtable+4) with this and the character value.
If the virtual single-character write returns 0xFFFF, stop the loop and return the current running total.
Fallback counters: advance source pointer a2, increment running total v9, decrement remaining count a3.
Return the total number of wide characters written (v9).
